name: Zellix - Buy on amazon with crypto
description: Utility extension for finding product codes and enabling buy with crypto button on amazon.com

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://api.coingecko.com; img-src 'self' https://m.media-amazon.com; default-src 'self'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self'
